observations: Photo 0: used gearbox on dirt ground with attached cables, hoses, and linkage; boots visible at bottom right.
Photo 1: second angle of a dirty gearbox assembly with a red filler cap and various pipes; boots visible at left.
Watermark "DE EKESON MOTORS" appears across both images.
No readable brand name, model number, or year marking on the unit in either photo.

claims.evidence: No badge or plate visible in photo 0 or photo 1
Photos show external assembly only; internal completeness and missing parts cannot be confirmed
No year marking visible on the unit
Condition is subjective and cannot be assessed remotely from exterior photos

risks.risk: Internal gears, bearings, or synchros may be damaged or worn out
risks.proof: Video of input/output shaft rotation with noise check, or workshop bench test

risks.risk: Unit may be missing bell housing, mounts, sensors, or shift linkage
risks.proof: Photos of all sides with a parts checklist
Video showing no seepage or pressure test

risks.risk: May not fit the buyer's specific Corolla engine/year
risks.proof: Part number stamped on casing or VIN compatibility confirmation

proof_requests: Clear photo of any casting number, part number, or manufacturer plate on the gearbox housing
Video of the gearbox shafts being turned by hand
Photos of the bell housing side and mounting points
Confirmation of whether it is manual or automatic
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used car gearbox by type, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working, incomplete, unknown fitment) without needing the exact model.
